_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Mudziko wu tsipa - Swiveli swa tifasi: {dice_summary}
Tifasi ta wena leti ri: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mfiri {current_player_id} u khoma! Kuxoma kwale ka tifasi {face_value} ku ❗️{count}, ku fana na ku ❗️{quantity}.
Mfiri {loser_id} (loko yo chela) u fela tifasi rimwe.
call.caller_loses:
Mfiri {current_player_id} u khoma! Kuxoma kwale ka tifasi {face_value} ku ❗️{count}, ku fana na ku >= {quantity}.
Mfiri {loser_id} (yo khoma) u fela tifasi rimwe.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ku endla xikombelo handle ko rhanga hi ku kombela.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Ntlango wo chuma swi ra hari ku ❗️'[Bid: X, Y]' ni '[Call]'. Ntlango lowu ngariweke: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Nhlayo yintshwa {new_quantity} yi le hansi ka ya sweswi {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Nxavo lowuntshwa {new_face_value} wu le hansi ka wa sweswi {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Nxavo wa yona wu fana ni lowu xavisiwaka sweswi.
bid_reason.face_range: Nhlayo ya kona yi fanele ku va exikarhi ka 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Mutlangi {player_id} u humile hikwalaho ka ku va a nga ri na mfanelo.

outcome.win: Mfiri {winner} u winga! Vuno ra masipala: {final_ranking}
